title: Add Music to Video Editor
summary: Add song to video, mix audio, trim music & add background music easily.
description:
ADD MUSIC & AUDIO TO VIDEO



Add music to video and photo easily. Add your favorite song, background music, mix multiple audio tracks, trim music, add text and emoji, create photo slideshows and export your finished video without watermark.



🎵 ADD MUSIC TO VIDEO

Choose music or audio from your device and add it to your video. Add your favorite music and create videos with the soundtrack you want in just a few simple steps.



🎶 ADD SONG TO VIDEO

Add a song to video and customize the soundtrack for your memories, trips, celebrations, social videos and everyday moments.



🎧 MIX AUDIO

Add multiple audio tracks and mix audio with video. Adjust different tracks and create your own audio mix for videos and photo slideshows.



✂️ TRIM AUDIO & MUSIC

Trim audio before adding it to your video. Choose the exact part of a song you want, trim music, adjust timing and sync the audio with your video.



🎼 ADD BACKGROUND MUSIC

Add background music to video and give your content the right mood. Choose audio from your device or explore the available music library.



🖼️ ADD MUSIC TO PHOTO

Turn your favorite photos into videos and add music to photo slideshows. Create photo videos for birthdays, travel memories, celebrations and social media.



🎬 CREATE PHOTO SLIDESHOWS

Create a slideshow from your photos and combine pictures with music, text and emoji to make memorable videos.



✍️ ADD TEXT TO VIDEO

Add text overlays to video and personalize your content with titles, captions and messages before exporting.



😊 ADD EMOJI TO VIDEO

Add emoji overlays to make your videos more expressive, creative and fun.



🎶 MUSIC LIBRARY

Browse the available music library and find audio that fits your videos, photos and slideshows.



🎨 CUSTOMIZE VIDEO BACKGROUND

Use blur or solid color backgrounds to customize videos and create a cleaner result for different aspect ratios.



📱 SIMPLE VIDEO & AUDIO EDITING

Add music, edit audio, mix tracks, trim music, add text and emoji and create photo slideshows with simple editing tools.



📤 EXPORT HD VIDEO

Export your finished video in HD quality and choose from popular video formats. Save your video to your device and share it with friends or social media.



✅ EXPORT WITHOUT WATERMARK

Create and export videos without watermark for a clean result that's ready to save and share.
